capabilities: count words or characters written each day
display daily counts on a calendar
choose which folders to include in counting
edit a day's word count by double-clicking its date
extras: The README is written mainly in Chinese with a bilingual feature list; it has no screenshots or usage instructions.
problem: Obsidian's word count is a single current total; it offers no history of how much was written on each day or progress toward writing goals.
